research_notes: Follow up family-business legal identities and commencement/management handover dates, QGC pipeline payroll employer and hours, Xstrata Wandoan contract dates, early station/timber employers and any paid work during the March–May 2022 parliamentary gap. Full-time status remains unverified throughout.

The 1990 earthmoving start does not mean Xstrata employed him continuously from 1990. Rural Land Development may describe activity rather than a legal entity. QGC is identified as project client, not automatically employer. State-forest location does not imply public employment.

Do not add farm, engineering, earthmoving and gas-project ranges without resolving shared business entities and overlapping hours. APH's undated small-business-owner label is represented by the named types of enterprises, not duplicated as an extra job.

Interests transcription supplies leads CE & TS Boyce, CE & TS Boyce Family Trust and Everest Earthmoving Pty Ltd, but original register and historical company/partnership records need review before attributing old employment to these entities. Financial interests alone are not counted as work.

Searched federal/state biographies, 2018 and 2022 maiden speeches, later apprenticeship speech, party/member biographies, employer/client and company-name searches, parliamentary record, interests transcription and full-time terms. Retrieved 2018 speech and Queensland record materially expand the official occupation summary; no reliable hours or complete earlier employer chronology found. Last follow-up 2026-09-29.
